title: Add upgrade comment to Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2") workaround sites
description: commands.rs lines 35, 90, 144 and mod.rs line 477 all construct Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2") because imap-types 2.0.0-alpha.6 has no Capability::Imap4Rev2 enum variant. There is no comment at any of these sites explaining: (a) why try_from is used instead of a named variant, (b) which upstream issue/PR tracks the missing variant, (c) what the migration looks like when upstream ships it (replace try_from with Capability::Imap4Rev2 and update the PartialEq-based test assertions in commands.rs that use try_from for contains() checks). Without this comment a future maintainer doing cargo update will see the workaround, not know if it is still needed, and have no grep anchor to find all the sites. Fix: add a // UPSTREAM-WORKAROUND(imap-types): no Capability::Imap4Rev2 variant yet; replace with Capability::Imap4Rev2 when available comment at each try_from("IMAP4rev2") call site and in the CapabilityEnable::try_from("IMAP4rev2") call in mod.rs.
